name: BetAxol Audience Insights
author: gerogs

sections.description:
Discover what your audience truly thinks with BetAxol AI, the ultimate sentiment analysis and AI-powered focus group tool for WordPress.

Whether you are a blogger, a digital agency, or a business owner, BetAxol AI seamlessly integrates advanced Natural Language Processing (via Google Gemini) directly into your WordPress dashboard to analyze the emotions behind every comment on your articles and products.

🌟 Free Features

  • Audience Thermometer: Automatically analyzes approved comments on your Posts, Pages, and Products.
  • Instant Sentiment Scoring: Displays a color-coded barometer (Positive, Neutral, Negative) inside your content editor.
  • AI Summary: Generates a concise, easy-to-read summary explaining why your audience feels that way.

🚀 PRO Features (BetAxol SaaS Subscription Required)

  • Live AI Focus Groups: Watch simulated AI personas (The Critic, The Supporter, The Analyst) debate your content in real-time.
  • Competitive Analysis: Compare your articles head-to-head against competitor URLs to identify your competitive advantage.
  • Social Media Listening: Scan Instagram, Facebook, and X (Twitter) for ongoing conversations about your brand.
  • Custom Personas: Create tailored AI agents that represent your exact target demographic.

External services

This plugin connects to the BetAxol Cloud API to perform Sentiment Analysis via Google Gemini. It is required to process the text of your comments returning the sentiment score without overloading your WordPress server.

When the “Analizar Sentimiento” button is pressed, the plugin sends the text of the approved comments, your site URL, and your API key to the BetAxol Cloud API. Nothing is sent automatically or in the background. Pro features (AI Focus Groups) are not embedded in your WordPress dashboard: the plugin links out to the BetAxol dashboard at https://app.regenaxo.com, which opens in a new browser tab.

This service is provided by “Regenaxo / BetAxol”:
* Terms of Use
* Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/betaxol-audience-insights directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the BetAxol AI menu in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your BetAxol API Key (register for free at https://app.regenaxo.com/apikeys).
  5. Open any Post, Page or Product and click the “Analizar Sentimiento con IA” button.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key to use this?

Yes. Our plugin relies on the BetAxol Cloud (powered by Google Gemini) to process heavy AI tasks without slowing down your WordPress server. You can generate a free API key at https://app.regenaxo.com/apikeys.

Are my comments used to train AI models?

No. We route all queries through Enterprise-level AI endpoints. Your confidential data is not used to train public language models.

Can I use this on WooCommerce products?

Yes! The Sentiment Thermometer metapost box works out-of-the-box for WooCommerce products if they have reviews (comments) enabled.
